claim_boundary: Retrospective 26-growth method-development outer LOO from frozen M22 after domain-expert exclusion of atypical AFM growth 6022. Sq, FSMI, morphology statistics and rendering fits exclude 6022 before every outer and inner fit. Low-Sq renderer selection is retrospective; the M22 rough branch is regression-protected and prospective confirmation remains required.

confidence.confidence_definition: Smoothed survival percentile of equal-weight ranks of strictly cross-fitted expected FSMI and island-topology errors. FSMI already contains height amplitude, so Rq is not double-counted.

protocol: retrospective nested leave-one-growth-out over the fixed harmonized 26-growth cohort
